# PoshWash Ireland

> PoshWash Ireland is a premier car wash and auto valet service located in Windy Arbour, Dundrum, Dublin 14, Ireland. Providing eco-friendly hand wash, interior vacuuming, full valet, and professional auto detailing services with walk-in availability 7 days a week.

## Business Overview
- **Business Name**: PoshWash Ireland
- **Tagline**: Premium car care with Irish hospitality
- **Location**: Windy Arbour, Dundrum, Dublin 14, Ireland
- **Coordinates**: Latitude 53.3014466, Longitude -6.2461258
- **Operating Hours**: Monday to Sunday, 09:00 - 18:00 (7 days a week)
- **Booking Policy**: Walk-in service only. No advance booking required (first-come, first-served basis).
- **Payment Method**: Cash Only (please prepare cash before arrival).
- **Account Customers**: Welcome for corporate and fleet services.

## Services & Transparent Pricing

### 1. Standard Wash
- **Cars**: €15
- **4x4 / MPV**: €20
- **Includes**: Professional exterior hand wash & drying, exterior window cleaning, door shuts cleaning, wheel treatment, and tyre shine.

### 2. Gold Wash
- **Cars**: €25
- **4x4 / MPV**: €30
- **Includes**: Everything in Standard Wash plus complete interior and exterior window cleaning for crystal clarity.

### 3. Standard Mini Valet
- **Cars**: €35
- **4x4 / MPV**: €40
- **Includes**: Complete exterior wash, interior vacuum cleaning, dashboard care & treatment, door shuts, and tyre shine.

### 4. Gold Mini Valet (Director's Choice / Most Popular)
- **Cars**: €45
- **4x4 / MPV**: €55
- **Includes**: Everything in Mini Valet plus bumper shine treatment, complete interior polishing, and premium finish.

### 5. Gold Valet (The Best!)
- **Cars**: €65
- **4x4 / MPV**: €75
- **Includes**: Professional wash & vacuum, meticulous hand polishing inside and out, premium detailing, and showroom finish.

### 6. Full Works Valet (Ultimate Car Care Experience)
- **Cars**: €110
- **4x4 / MPV**: €130
- **Includes**: Complete vehicle transformation, deep upholstery shampoo & wash, professional hand polish, and like-new finish.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
- **Do I need to book in advance?** No, simply drive in to Windy Arbour, Dundrum. All services operate on a walk-in, first-come, first-served basis.
- **What payment methods are accepted?** Cash only.
- **Do you wash large SUVs, 4x4s, and MPVs?** Yes, dedicated rates apply for 4x4s and MPVs for all service tiers.
- **Can I get an instant quote?** Yes, send vehicle photos via WhatsApp to [+353 85 205 0409](https://wa.me/353852050409).
